purpose: Teach: 埋まっ/労組/貸出/定休/代え/所存/営ん/取調べ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の倉庫、在庫で埋まってしまったぞ
lines.en: Our warehouse has gotten completely packed with inventory.
lines.style: Clipped, direct opening. Factual tone with a note of frustration underneath. Short phrasing. No apology in the delivery — this is a problem that needs stating and fixing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。労組と協議を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're working through discussions with the union right now.
lines.style: Measured, professional. Even pace. Slight deference to the hierarchy but not submissive — this is an update on work in progress. Calm assurance that the process is moving.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員食堂の貸出ロッカーを整えろ
lines.en: Sort out the employee locker system in the cafeteria.
lines.style: Sharp instruction, no excess words. Direct eye contact level. The tone of someone who expects competence and doesn't need to raise his voice to get it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。来週水曜は定休にいたします
lines.en: Yes. We're closing it next Wednesday as scheduled.
lines.style: Brisk acknowledgment. Already thinking two steps ahead. Professional courtesy in the tone — he's confirming that he's understood the directive and the action is already planned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業者を代えての対応を検討しろ
lines.en: Consider changing vendors to address this properly.
lines.style: Steady instruction with an undertone of expectation. Not a suggestion. The slight pause before 'address' carries weight — this matters. Clear final consonants on the instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、当社、品質向上にお応えする所存です
lines.en: Yes. Our company is committed to meeting your expectations on quality improvement.
lines.style: Formal assurance delivered with quiet conviction. Slightly longer phrasing to show respect and seriousness. The words land carefully — this is not rote but genuine commitment spoken aloud to the boss.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 長年、この事業を営んできた誇りを忘れるな
lines.en: Don't lose sight of the pride we've built running this business for all these years.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. The opening hits with weight — 'don't lose sight' is an appeal beneath the directive. Slight slowdown on 'all these years' — this carries history. Final phrase lands with quiet emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内取調べを実施しております
lines.en: Yes. We're conducting an internal investigation right now.
lines.style: Quiet closure. Slight fatigue underneath the professionalism — this is a serious step, not routine. Measured pace. The final word trails slightly, as if to say 'and we're taking it seriously.'
